headline: Micron job posting combines full-chip AMS verification with AI-assisted coding
fact: A Micron careers posting for an AMS verification role describes full-chip analog, digital, and firmware interaction, behavioral models, power-cycle verification, and use of AI-assisted coding to automate design and analysis work. This is evidence of the capabilities requested in a public hiring mandate, not proof that a specific AI-assisted flow was already deployed or measured.

sources.title: Micron Careers requisition JR93301
sources.summary: Official Micron requisition JR93301, posted March 4, 2026, describes the full-chip AMS, behavioral-model, power-cycle, and required AI-assisted-coding scope.
